title: Free-transform rotate translates the shape instead of rotating around its pivot
description:
REPRO: Select a shape on the stage, grab the free-transform rotate handle (circle above top-center), and drag to rotate. Instead of spinning in place, the shape's visual position drifts/orbits across the stage — its rendered x/y shifts while rotating.

ROOT CAUSE (handler-vs-renderer PIVOT MISMATCH; pivot is NOT the shape's center):
1. TransformHandles.tsx (packages/authoring-ui/src/TransformHandles.tsx:104-135) correctly computes the rotate pivot as the BOUNDING-BOX CENTER (cx=ob.x+ob.width/2, cy=ob.y+ob.height/2) and passes it to onRotate(delta, cx, cy).
2. The Shell handler handleFreeTransformRotate (packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx:1369-1381) IGNORES the originX/originY args (params are named _originX/_originY) and updates ONLY { rotation: origRotation + deltaAngle }. It never adjusts the object's x/y to keep the visual pivot fixed.
3. The renderer rotates the shape around (obj.x, obj.y) — the shape's LOCAL ORIGIN — not around the bounding-box center: packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts:1581-1583 does ctx.translate(obj.x, obj.y) -> ctx.rotate(rotation) -> ctx.scale(...), and renderShape draws the paths at offset (0,0). Confirmed by transformedShapeBounds (packages/core/src/engine/shapes.ts:58-113), whose own doc-comment states 'the transform origin is (obj.x, obj.y)'.
4. Editor-drawn shapes bake ABSOLUTE drawn coordinates into the path geometry (createRectShape, packages/core/src/engine/shapes.ts:166-193, uses the raw left/top/right/bottom) with obj.x=obj.y=0, so the local origin (obj.x,obj.y)=(0,0) is far from the bounding-box center (e.g. geometry at 200..300,150..250). Rotating around (0,0) sweeps the shape across the stage like a clock hand — exactly the reported 'shape moves while rotating'.

So: the rotate handle pivots visually around the box center, but the model rotation pivots around the shape's local origin (typically 0,0). When local origin != box center (true for all editor-drawn shapes), the shape orbits instead of spinning in place.

REGRESSION VERDICT: LONG-STANDING, not a recent regression. handleFreeTransformRotate was introduced in commit 4b4e4cf ('initial progress') already ignoring _originX/_originY; the renderer's translate->rotate-around-(obj.x,obj.y) is original. The recent StageArea re-theme (206830f, color-only) and the Distort/Envelope warp work (task 1219, ee7c148) did NOT touch this path. HEAD at investigation: 7b4ed09fa4edf625677fad5a83886ee2437ad12f.

EXPECTED: Rotating via the free-transform handle spins the shape in place around its bounding-box center (or registration pivot); the pivot's stage position stays fixed.
ACTUAL: rotation pivots around the shape's local origin (obj.x,obj.y, usually 0,0), so the whole shape orbits — its rendered position drifts.

FIX DIRECTION: Make the handler's pivot agree with the renderer's rotation origin. Two equivalent approaches:
(a) In handleFreeTransformRotate, given the box-center pivot (originX,originY), compensate obj.x/obj.y so that the point that was at (originX,originY) before the rotation delta stays there after: rotate (obj.x-originX, obj.y-originY) by deltaAngle around the pivot and write back the new obj.x/obj.y alongside the new rotation. This keeps the visual center fixed even though the renderer rotates about (obj.x,obj.y).
(b) Alternatively, normalize shape geometry to be centered on its own origin (paths relative to center, obj.x/obj.y = box center) at creation/commit time so the local origin IS the pivot — but this is a larger change touching shape factories, bounds, hit-testing, and SWF export, so (a) is the targeted fix.
Cross-check against the renderer note in CLAUDE.md ('translate(x,y)->rotate->skew->scale around the registration origin') and the bitmap pivot handling (renderBitmapObject) which already pivots at the registration origin.

ACCEPTANCE: a unit/e2e test that places a shape, applies a rotation via the free-transform rotate path, and asserts the transformedShapeBounds CENTER (and ideally the registration/box-center pivot) is invariant under rotation (before-center == after-center within epsilon for several angles, e.g. 30/90/180 deg). Bounding-box center must not move when only rotating.
